playbook.note: The only existing zh-TW rendering (webapp admin permissions: 管理私人指南). Alternatives 教戰手冊/劇本 exist in Taiwan usage but keep 指南 for consistency with what admins already see.

run.note: Noun and verb both 執行; as a countable noun prefer phrasing like 一次執行 or 執行項目. Run playbook → 執行指南.

retrospective.note: Agile convention in Taiwan (衝刺回顧); distinct from recap, which the core glossary maps to 重點回顧.

owner.note: 責任 semantics fit 負責人 better than 擁有者; run owner → 執行負責人.

follower.note: Follow/Unfollow → 追蹤/取消追蹤, matching the core thread terminology.

trigger.note: Verb: 觸發. Core webapp uses 觸發關鍵字 for keyword trigger words.

action.note: Run/Task/Channel Actions → 執行動作/任務動作/頻道動作.

due date.note: Due → 截止; No due date → 無截止日期.

template.note: Taiwan convention; do not use 模板 (Simplified convention).

assignee.note: assign → 指派, matching existing webapp usage.

filter.note: Noun: 篩選器. Legacy webapp strings often use 過濾/過濾器; 篩選 is the current Taiwan UI convention — use 篩選 in Playbooks and note the webapp inconsistency.

attribute.note: Property Fields → 屬性欄位; distinct from user profile attributes (same word, different scope).

section.note: Section name → 區段名稱; Add a section → 新增區段.
